description: As per the requirements of our Interact Club at Diamond Jubilee Girls High School, the Rotary Club of Bombay Metropolitan has generously provided a sanitary napkin vending machine, gifted 31 tote bags as a return gift of Rakhi's & Diwali Diya's made by students, and distributed 134 spectacles to the girls on 30th Oct 2026.
